description: Shared by both engines: resolving a design system for the theme, mode and appearance a UI profile asks for.

cases.name: default theme, first mode
cases.description: a profile that chooses nothing gets the default theme in the first mode, with the values the design system resolved

cases.name: dark scheme
cases.description: the dark colour scheme selects the dark mode; its components are evaluated from the anatomy

cases.name: system follows the system
cases.description: the system scheme selects the mode the system is in

cases.name: named theme
cases.description: a profile's theme name selects that theme

cases.name: unknown theme
cases.description: a theme nobody has falls back to the default theme and says so

diagnostics.message: The theme 'Nowhere' is not a theme of the design system 'ShopDesign' or of its packages, so the default theme is used.

cases.name: scheme that is not a mode
cases.description: a colour scheme the design system does not declare as a mode uses its first mode and says so

diagnostics.message: The colour scheme dark is not a mode of the design system 'DayNight', so its first mode is used.

cases.name: mode the theme does not implement
cases.description: a theme without values for the mode is drawn without them: every part is unresolved

diagnostics.message: The theme 'Dusk' has no values for the mode 'dark'.
Button.primary: part 'text' refers to 'color.on-primary', which has no value.
Button.primary: part 'background' refers to 'color.primary', which has no value.
Button.primary: part 'radius' refers to 'radius.control', which has no value.
Button.primary.focus: part 'shadow' refers to 'shadow.ring', which has no value.
Button.primary.disabled: part 'text' refers to 'color.text', which has no value.
Button.primary.disabled: part 'background' refers to 'color.surface', which has no value.
Page.default: part 'background' refers to 'color.surface', which has no value.
Page.default: part 'text' refers to 'color.text', which has no value.
Page.default: part 'font' refers to 'font.sans', which has no value.

cases.name: accent, corners and font
cases.description: the profile's accent, corners and font replace the roles the design system binds; the components are evaluated again

cases.name: nothing bound
cases.description: a design system that binds nothing ignores the profile's accent and says so

cases.name: theme shipped by a package
cases.description: a theme a package ships supplies the values of the roles, in the mode it declares; parts it has no value for are left out without a problem

cases.name: dark theme shipped by a package
cases.description: a dark package theme is drawn in the dark mode

cases.name: package theme against the other scheme
cases.description: a package theme has one scheme of its own; asking for the other is reported and the theme is drawn as chosen

cases.name: design system theme wins over a package theme of the same name
cases.description: a theme the design system has is not shadowed by a package's
